comment:dashboard: CLOUD-35: the dashboard is its OWN sub-package (apps/cloud/dashboard) with its own tsconfig (jsx: react-jsx, DOM/React types) + build/typecheck. The convex-side tsc here must NOT compile its .tsx — that needs jsx + browser types this config deliberately lacks. So `dashboard` is dropped from `include` and excluded below; it is typechecked by `pnpm -C apps/cloud/dashboard typecheck`.
